CONTRACT (scout + collab, implemented)
solve rejects non-finite epsilon/rhoRows/rhoCols/tolerance; requires epsilon>0, penalties>=0, tolerance>0, maxIterations>0. Existing InvalidConfig. Zero rho remains a lawful control (unconstrained marginal). Cost/marginal finiteness is NOT claimed closed.

HOW
invalidFields uses fail-closed polarity (`isFinite && > 0` / `>= 0`). The InvalidConfig detail names every rejected field so a sibling cannot hide behind a generic message.

TWO AGGREGATE LAWS
- invalid scale parameters are InvalidConfig and name the field (NaN/+Inf/-Inf/0/-1 epsilon; NaN/+Inf/-1 rhos)
- invalid stopping parameters are InvalidConfig and name the field (NaN/0/-1/+Inf tolerance; 0/-1 maxIterations)
